results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd
results.source_text:
/-- `gcd a b` is a (non-unique) element such that `gcd a b ∣ a` `gcd a b ∣ b`, and for
  any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b` -/
def gcd (a b : R) : R :=
  if a0 : a = 0 then b
  else
    have _ := mod_lt b a0
    gcd (b % a) a
termination_by a
results.docstring:

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd_eq_left
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_eq_left {a b : R} : gcd a b = a ↔ a ∣ b :=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rw [← h]
    apply gcd_dvd_right, fun h => by rw [gcd_val, mod_eq_zero.2 h, gcd_zero_left]⟩

results.name: EuclideanDomain.dvd_gcd
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_gcd {a b c : R} : c ∣ a → c ∣ b → c ∣ gcd a b :=
  GCD.induction a b (fun _ _ H => by simpa only [gcd_zero_left] using H) fun a b _ IH ca cb => by
    rw [gcd_val]
    exact IH ((dvd_mod_iff ca).2 cb) ca

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_dvd (a b : R) : gcd a b ∣ a ∧ gcd a b ∣ b :=
  GCD.induction a b
    (fun b => by
      rw [gcd_zero_left]
      exact ⟨dvd_zero _, dvd_rfl⟩)
    fun a b _ ⟨IH₁, IH₂⟩ => by
    rw [gcd_val]
    exact ⟨IH₂, (dvd_mod_iff IH₂).1 IH₁⟩

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_dvd_left (a b : R) : gcd a b ∣ a :=
  (gcd_dvd a b).left

/-- A right-regular element is an element `c` such that multiplication on the right by `c`
is injective. -/
@[to_additive (attr := instance_reducible)
  /-- An add-right-regular element is an element `c` such that addition
    on the right by `c` is injective. -/]
def IsRightRegular (c : R) :=
  (· * c).Injective

results.name: Fermion.contr_rightDualRightUnit

/-- Contraction on the right with `rightDualRightUnit` does nothing. -/
lemma contr_rightDualRightUnit (x : DualRightHandedWeyl) :
    (TensorProduct.lid ℂ _ <|
    dualRightContraction.toLinearMap.rTensor _ <|
    (TensorProduct.assoc ℂ _ _ _).symm <|
    x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (rightDualRightUnit (1 : ℂ))) = x := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℂ).mp
    (Basis.mem_span DualRightHandedWeyl.basis x)
  subst hc
  simp [- Fintype.sum_sum_type, smul_tmul, dualRightContraction_basis,
    rightDualRightUnit_apply_one, rightDualRightUnitVal_expand_tmul, add_tmul, tmul_add]
results.docstring: Contraction on the right with `rightDualRightUnit` does nothing.
